title: Publish latest changes to production (icp0.io)

requirements.text: Publish the current app changes by redeploying the project to production and verify the live site is reachable at https://romanticproposal.icp0.io.
acceptanceCriteria: A production deployment is executed using the project’s standard deployment workflow.
https://romanticproposal.icp0.io loads successfully in a browser and displays the latest UI (including the success screen heading text "She said yes").
No deployment/build errors remain blocking the publish step.

constraints: Do not change the single-actor backend architecture.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Adding new UI features or changing app behavior beyond what is necessary to publish the current state.
Introducing new backend APIs or persistence.
